selection_note: Ibiza-based roles posted within the previous month, verified live, relevant to sales, marketing, events or transferable commercial/content work, and explicitly suitable where English is the required language and Spanish is optional rather than mandatory. British applicants still need the legal right to work in Spain; neither retained listing states that sponsorship is available.
language_note: English-only filter applied. Roles requiring Spanish or another non-English language were excluded. An English-language advert alone was not treated as proof that English is sufficient.
